resources.shortDescription: Example placeholder prompt: a slow rising reveal of a glass office tower at morning light.
resources.description: Placeholder resource used to demonstrate the library layout, prompt viewer and download flow. Replace this text, the prompt and the attached files with the real guide through the admin dashboard.
resources.promptContent:
[EXAMPLE PROMPT — placeholder]
Slow cinematic camera rise along a glass office tower facade, morning light, reflections moving across the curtain wall, city street below waking up, photorealistic architectural video, steady motion, no people close to camera.

instructions.title: Prepare the still
instructions.body: Start from a clean, high-resolution exterior photograph with the full tower in frame and no motion blur.

instructions.title: Paste the prompt
instructions.body: Copy the prompt into your video platform and set the duration to 8–10 seconds for a controlled rise.

instructions.title: Direct the motion
instructions.body: Keep camera motion to a single axis. If the model adds a pan, reduce motion strength and regenerate.

instructions.title: Finish
instructions.body: Trim the first and last half-second, where AI video artefacts are most common.

resources.title: Glass Tower Reveal — Placeholder Example

resources.shortDescription: Example placeholder guide: a continuous walkthrough from street gate to inner courtyard.
resources.description: Placeholder resource demonstrating the guide format with step-by-step instructions. Replace with the real walkthrough workflow via the admin dashboard.
resources.promptContent:
[EXAMPLE PROMPT — placeholder]
Continuous forward walkthrough through a house entrance into a sunlit inner courtyard, smooth steady camera at eye level, warm afternoon light, architectural photography style, no cuts.

instructions.title: Plan the path
instructions.body: Sketch the camera path first: gate, passage, courtyard. One continuous move, no turns sharper than 45 degrees.

instructions.title: Generate in segments
instructions.body: Produce three short clips (approach, passage, courtyard) with matching light direction, then join them on the cut points.

instructions.title: Match the light
instructions.body: Keep the sun position consistent across segments; mismatched shadows are the most visible join artefact.

instructions.title: Stabilise and grade
instructions.body: Apply light stabilisation and a single warm grade across all segments so they read as one shot.

resources.title: Courtyard House Walkthrough — Placeholder Guide

resources.shortDescription: Example placeholder workflow: morph a weathered facade into its renovated state in one shot.
resources.description: Placeholder premium resource demonstrating access control on downloads. Replace with the real transformation workflow via the admin dashboard.
resources.promptContent:
[EXAMPLE PROMPT — placeholder]
Locked-off camera on a weathered brick facade; the surface gradually restores itself — mortar repoints, windows clear, stone cleans — ending as a fully renovated facade in the same light, photorealistic, no camera movement.

instructions.title: Align the pair
instructions.body: Prepare matched before/after stills from the identical viewpoint; alignment matters more than resolution.

instructions.title: Use first/last frame control
instructions.body: Set the weathered image as the first frame and the renovated image as the last frame where the platform supports it.

instructions.title: Control the transition
instructions.body: Ask for a gradual, even transformation. Localised morphing usually means the stills are misaligned.

instructions.title: Clean the edges
instructions.body: Mask and re-composite window reflections in an editor if the model warps them.

resources.shortDescription: Example placeholder prompt: a building rising in timelapse from one site photograph.
resources.description: Placeholder resource demonstrating the prompt format for timelapse work. Replace with real content via the admin dashboard.
resources.promptContent:
[EXAMPLE PROMPT — placeholder]
Construction timelapse from a fixed viewpoint: foundations, frame rising floor by floor, crane moving, facade panels installed, ending with the completed building, fast clouds, changing daylight, photorealistic.

instructions.title: Choose the viewpoint
instructions.body: Use a wide, elevated site photo with room above the finished building height.

instructions.title: Prompt the sequence
instructions.body: List the construction stages in order; models follow listed sequences more reliably than single sentences.

instructions.title: Extend in passes
instructions.body: Generate the first stage, then extend from the last frame for each following stage.

resources.shortDescription: Example placeholder prompt: carry one facade from noon through dusk to lit night.
resources.description: Placeholder resource demonstrating day-to-night prompt structure. Replace with real content via the admin dashboard.
resources.promptContent:
[EXAMPLE PROMPT — placeholder]
Static camera on a residential facade as daylight fades through golden hour into blue dusk; windows light up one by one, warm interior glow, deep blue sky, photorealistic timelapse feel.

instructions.title: Lock the camera
instructions.body: Any camera drift breaks the day-to-night illusion; prompt for a static shot explicitly.

instructions.title: Sequence the light
instructions.body: Name the phases in order — noon, golden hour, dusk, night — so the transition stays even.

instructions.title: Windows last
instructions.body: Ask for windows to light near the end; early window light is the most common failure.

resources.title: Day-to-Night Facade Transition — Placeholder

resources.shortDescription: Example placeholder prompt: a slow pan across a calm, minimal living space.
resources.description: Placeholder resource demonstrating interior prompt structure. Replace with real content via the admin dashboard.
resources.promptContent:
[EXAMPLE PROMPT — placeholder]
Slow horizontal pan across a minimal living room, soft daylight from large windows, linen and oak textures, gentle shadows moving, calm architectural interior photography, no people.

instructions.title: Declutter the still
instructions.body: Interior models amplify clutter; start from the cleanest composition you have.

instructions.title: One motion only
instructions.body: A pan or a push-in — never both. Combined moves are where interiors warp.

instructions.title: Protect straight lines
instructions.body: If door frames bend, lower the motion amount before changing the prompt.

resources.title: Minimal Interior Pan — Placeholder

resources.shortDescription: Example placeholder guide: a low aerial pass over a planted courtyard.
resources.description: Placeholder premium guide demonstrating the format. Replace with real content via the admin dashboard.
resources.promptContent:
[EXAMPLE PROMPT — placeholder]
Low aerial flyover across a planted courtyard garden toward a stone pavilion, morning mist in the planting beds, slow steady drone movement, cinematic architectural landscape.

instructions.title: Set the altitude in words
instructions.body: Say "low aerial, just above the planting" — models interpret height from language, not numbers.

instructions.title: Give the camera a destination
instructions.body: Name the building the move ends on; open-ended flyovers drift.

instructions.title: Watch the foliage
instructions.body: Planting is the first thing to shimmer; reduce saturation slightly in the grade to hide it.

resources.shortDescription: Example placeholder bundle: atrium reveal, light study and visitor-scale shots for one space.
resources.description: Placeholder premium bundle demonstrating multi-file resources (prompt file, guide PDF and ZIP bundle). Replace with the real bundle via the admin dashboard.
resources.promptContent:
[EXAMPLE PROMPT — placeholder]
Grand museum atrium, camera arcs slowly from the entrance toward a sweeping staircase as a shaft of sunlight moves across the stone floor, visitors as soft distant silhouettes, cinematic architectural film.

instructions.title: Build the shot list
instructions.body: Three shots: wide reveal, light study, human scale. Generate them in that order so light direction matches.

instructions.title: Keep people distant
instructions.body: Close figures break realism; keep visitors as background silhouettes.

instructions.title: Grade as one film
instructions.body: One LUT across all three shots sells the single-location illusion.

resources.shortDescription: Example placeholder workflow: orbit a twisting parametric tower concept visual.
resources.description: Placeholder resource demonstrating visualization workflows. Replace with real content via the admin dashboard.
resources.promptContent:
[EXAMPLE PROMPT — placeholder]
Slow orbital camera move around a twisting parametric tower concept model, white facade panels with soft shadows, neutral studio sky, architectural visualization style, clean and minimal.

instructions.title: Export a clean still
instructions.body: Render the concept model against a plain sky; busy backgrounds fight the orbit.

instructions.title: Limit the arc
instructions.body: Ask for a quarter orbit at most per generation, then chain from the last frame.

instructions.title: Fix panel shimmer
instructions.body: A slight blur pass on the facade in post hides panel flicker without softening the silhouette.

resources.shortDescription: Example placeholder guide: reveal a restored heritage interior from its derelict state.
resources.description: Placeholder resource demonstrating the guide format for renovation work. Replace with real content via the admin dashboard.
resources.promptContent:
[EXAMPLE PROMPT — placeholder]
Interior of a derelict heritage hall gradually restoring: plaster repairs, timber beams return, tall windows clear, warm light returns, locked camera, photorealistic renovation reveal.

instructions.title: Respect the fabric
instructions.body: List the elements that must survive unchanged — models love to "improve" heritage details away.

instructions.title: Restore in order
instructions.body: Structure first, surfaces second, light last; the sequence reads as real renovation.

instructions.title: Compare against the survey
instructions.body: Check the final frame against survey photos before publishing the sequence.
